question: Which sector is responsible for providing electricity in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Mining
Agriculture
Textile
Power
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Power

Explanation:
The responsibility of providing electricity in India lies with the Power sector. This sector handles generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity. Under the Ministry of Power, various public and private companies operate, such as NTPC, Power Grid Corporation, and State Electricity Boards. Mining, Agriculture, and Textile sectors are not directly involved in electricity provision; mining extracts fuels like coal, agriculture uses electricity, and textile industry consumes it.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Largest power generation company in India → NTPC
☛ Main company for power transmission → Power Grid Corporation of India
☛ Authority under Ministry of Power → CEA (Central Electricity Authority)
☛ Who distributes electricity in India → State Electricity Boards and private DISCOMs
☛ Major source of electricity generation in India → Coal (Thermal Power)
question_hi: भारत में बिजली उपलब्ध कराने के लिए कौन सा क्षेत्र जिम्मेदार है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)

वस्त्र

भारत में बिजली उपलब्ध कराने की जिम्मेदारी विद्युत क्षेत्र की है। यह क्षेत्र बिजली के उत्पादन, पारेषण और वितरण का कार्य करता है। भारत सरकार के विद्युत मंत्रालय के तहत कई सार्वजनिक और निजी कंपनियाँ काम करती हैं, जैसे NTPC, Power Grid Corporation, और State Electricity Boards। खनन, कृषि और वस्त्र क्षेत्र बिजली उत्पादन से संबंधित नहीं हैं; खनन कोयला जैसे ईंधन निकालता है, कृषि बिजली का उपयोग करती है, और वस्त्र उद्योग बिजली का उपभोग करता है।

question: What is ‘Northern Circar’ in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Name of river valley
Name of plateau
Name of mountain peak
Name of coastal plain
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Name of coastal plain

Explanation:
Northern Circars is a name given to a coastal plain located on the eastern coast of India. This region extends across the coastal parts of Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. During the British period, these areas were called 'Circars', and they were divided into five main regions: Ganjam, Visakhapatnam, Godavari, Krishna, and Guntur. The region lies along the Bay of Bengal and its economy is mainly based on agriculture and fishing. The term 'Northern Circars' is also found in ancient and medieval Indian history, referring to the fertile coastal belt that was ruled by various dynasties before the British.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Where is Northern Circars located? → On the eastern coast of India
☛ Which states include Northern Circars? → Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
☛ How many regions was Northern Circars divided into? → Five
☛ Northern Circars is associated with which sea? → Bay of Bengal
☛ What is the main economic base of Northern Circars? → Agriculture and fishing

Explanation:
उत्तरी सरकार (Northern Circars) भारत के पूर्वी तट पर स्थित एक तटीय मैदान का नाम है। यह क्षेत्र आंध्र प्रदेश और ओडिशा के तटीय भागों में फैला हुआ है। ब्रिटिश काल में इन्हें 'सरकार' कहा जाता था, और ये पाँच प्रमुख क्षेत्रों में विभाजित थे: गंजाम, विशाखापट्टनम, गोदावरी, कृष्णा और गुंटूर। यह क्षेत्र बंगाल की खाड़ी के किनारे स्थित है और यहाँ की अर्थव्यवस्था मुख्यतः कृषि और मछली पकड़ने पर निर्भर है। उत्तरी सरकार का उल्लेख प्राचीन और मध्यकालीन भारतीय इतिहास में भी मिलता है।

question: Which type of vegetation is mostly found in the Thar Desert? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Deciduous forests
Thorny bushes and shrubs
Alpine vegetation
Tropical rainforest
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Thorny bushes and shrubs

Explanation:
The Thar Desert is a hot and arid region with annual rainfall less than 25 cm. Due to extreme temperatures and low water availability, thorny bushes and shrubs thrive here. These plants are adapted to survive with minimal water through features like leaves reduced to spines, thick bark, and deep root systems. Common species include Acacia, Khejri (Prosopis cineraria), and various grasses. Deciduous forests, alpine vegetation, and tropical rainforests cannot exist in desert conditions as they require high moisture and suitable climate. Thus, the Thar Desert predominantly supports thorny bushes and shrubs.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Main vegetation of Thar Desert → Thorny bushes and shrubs
☛ Common tree found in Thar Desert → Khejri (Prosopis cineraria)
☛ Climate of Thar Desert → Extremely hot and dry
☛ Average annual rainfall in Thar Desert → Less than 25 cm
☛ Adaptation of thorny plants in Thar Desert → Leaves reduced to spines to conserve water
question_hi: थार मरुस्थल में किस प्रकार की वनस्पति अधिकतर पाई जाती है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)
options_hi: पर्णपाती वन
काँटेदार झाड़ियाँ और झाड़ीदार पौधे
अल्पाइन वनस्पति
उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है काँटेदार झाड़ियाँ और झाड़ीदार पौधे

Explanation:
थार मरुस्थल एक गर्म और शुष्क रेगिस्तान है, जहाँ वार्षिक वर्षा 25 सेमी से भी कम होती है। अत्यधिक तापमान और कम जल उपलब्धता के कारण यहाँ काँटेदार झाड़ियाँ और झाड़ीदार पौधे पनपते हैं। ये वनस्पतियाँ कम पानी में जीवित रहने के लिए अनुकूलित होती हैं, जैसे कि पत्तियों का काँटों में रूपांतरण, मोटी छाल, और गहरी जड़ें। सामान्य प्रजातियों में बबूल (Acacia), खेजड़ी (Prosopis cineraria) और विभिन्न प्रकार की घास शामिल हैं। पर्णपाती वन, अल्पाइन वनस्पति और उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षावन थार जैसे रेगिस्तानी क्षेत्रों में संभव नहीं हैं, क्योंकि उन्हें अधिक नमी और उपयुक्त जलवायु चाहिए। इस प्रकार, थार मरुस्थल में काँटेदार झाड़ियाँ और झाड़ीदार पौधे प्रमुख वनस्पति प्रकार हैं।

question: Which mountain range is a source of marble in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Vindhyas
Himalayas
Satpuras
Aravallis
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Aravallis

Explanation:
The primary source of marble in India is the Aravalli Range. This mountain range is located in Rajasthan and is known for producing high-quality white marble. Makrana in Rajasthan is a famous marble-producing region, and its marble is world-renowned. The Aravalli Range is one of the oldest mountain ranges in the world, extending approximately 800 km from Gujarat to Delhi. Among the other options, the Vindhyas are known for sandstone and limestone, while the Himalayas are not a major source of marble. The Satpuras are mainly known for wildlife and minerals. The marble from the Aravallis has been used in iconic structures like the Taj Mahal.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Which mountain range is a major source of marble in India? → Aravallis
☛ Which region in Rajasthan is famous for marble production? → Makrana
☛ Which states does the Aravalli Range extend through? → Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, Delhi
☛ Which is the oldest mountain range in India? → Aravalli
☛ The Taj Mahal is built from which type of stone? → Marble (from Makrana)
question_hi: भारत में संगमरमर का स्रोत कौन सी पर्वतमाला है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)

सतपुड़ा

Explanation:
भारत में संगमरमर का प्रमुख स्रोत अरावली पर्वतमाला है। यह पर्वतमाला राजस्थान में स्थित है और यहाँ से उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला सफेद संगमरमर निकाला जाता है। मकराना, राजस्थान का एक प्रमुख संगमरमर उत्पादक क्षेत्र है, जहाँ का संगमरमर विश्व प्रसिद्ध है। अरावली पर्वतमाला दुनिया की सबसे पुरानी पर्वत श्रृंखलाओं में से एक है। यह लगभग 800 किमी तक फैली हुई है और इसका विस्तार गुजरात से लेकर दिल्ली तक है। अन्य विकल्पों में, विंध्य पर्वत बलुआ पत्थर और चूना पत्थर के लिए जाना जाता है, जबकि हिमालय में संगमरमर का प्रमुख स्रोत नहीं है। सतपुड़ा पर्वत मुख्यतः वन्यजीव और खनिजों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

question_hi: पूर्व-पश्चिम कॉरिडोर की योजना भारत के निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य में स्थित सिलचर को गुजरात के बंदरगाह शहर पोरबंदर से जोड़ने के लिए बनाई गई है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)

question: As per Advancing Monsoon in India, which of the following cities receives rainfall the earliest? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Lucknow
Nagpur
Chandigarh
Bengaluru
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bengaluru

Explanation:
The monsoon in India arrives from the southwest, first reaching the Kerala coast. It then advances towards the northeast and north. Bengaluru is located in southern India, which causes it to be affected earlier by the monsoon compared to other options. question: Which of the following crops is primarily cultivated in black soil regions of India?  (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 3)

Explanation:

Cotton's deep roots develop well in this soil. Rice and sugarcane require waterlogged conditions, while tea grows in acidic red soil. Apart from cotton, black soil is also suitable for wheat, groundnut, and soybean. The unique properties of black soil, such as self-plowing and nutrient richness, support cotton as the primary crop in these regions.

question: What is the Standard Meridian of India? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: 77°30' E
90° 30' E
68°7' E
82°30' E
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 82°30' E

Explanation:
India's Standard Meridian is 82°30' East longitude, which passes through Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh. This line is used as the basis for Indian Standard Time (IST), which is 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). The meridian was chosen to pass approximately through the center of the country to maintain a uniform time across the nation. Although India spans about 30° of longitude from east to west, a single standard time is observed. The 82°30' E line is officially known as the Standard Meridian of India.

question: Which of the following metals is extracted from the Monazite sand in plenty in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Copper
Thorium
Gold
Bauxite
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Thorium

Explanation:
Monazite sand is a major source of Thorium, a radioactive metal used in nuclear energy production. India has the world's largest thorium reserves, estimated at about 4.6 lakh tonnes, mainly found in the coastal sands of Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Odisha. Monazite minerals contain rare earth elements and thorium phosphate. India's three-stage nuclear power programme is designed to eventually use thorium as fuel, as it is more abundant than uranium. Thorium is not fissile itself but can be converted to uranium-233 in a reactor. The extraction of thorium from monazite is a key part of India's energy strategy. Thorium is considered a cleaner and safer nuclear fuel compared to uranium.

question: Which region in India has the highest annual rainfall? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Ladakh
East Khasi Hills
Western Rajasthan
Northern Ganga plain
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is East Khasi Hills

Explanation:
The highest annual rainfall in India is recorded in the East Khasi Hills of Meghalaya, specifically at Mawsynram (and nearby Cherrapunji). Mawsynram receives an average annual rainfall of about 11,872 mm, making it the wettest place on Earth. This heavy rainfall is primarily due to the southwest monsoon winds that carry moisture from the Bay of Bengal and are forced to rise over the Khasi Hills, causing orographic precipitation. In contrast, Ladakh receives less than 100 mm annually, Western Rajasthan is arid, and the Northern Ganga plain experiences moderate rainfall.

question: Which plateau in India is known for its rich gold deposits? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 1)

Malwa Plateau
solution:

Explanation:
The Chota Nagpur Plateau in India is known for its rich gold deposits. Located primarily in Jharkhand, it is often called the mineral heartland of India. This plateau is part of the Gondwana landmass and has an average elevation of 600 to 900 meters. The Damodar River valley, which flows through the plateau, is a major coal-producing region. question: How did globalisation impact Indian agriculture after 1991? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Enhanced competition and access to global markets
Decreased crop yields
Complete reliance on imports
Increased subsidies for farmers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Enhanced competition and access to global markets

Explanation:
After the 1991 economic reforms, globalisation led to enhanced competition and access to global markets for Indian agriculture. India liberalised agricultural trade, reduced import tariffs, and promoted exports. This provided farmers with new markets and encouraged the production of high-value crops. However, fluctuations in international prices and subsidies in developed countries posed challenges. Crop yields did not decrease; in fact, production increased in some sectors. There was no complete reliance on imports; exports grew significantly. Subsidies for farmers were reduced, not increased. Overall, globalisation made Indian agriculture more competitive and market-oriented, integrating it with the world economy.

question: As of October 2024, which of the following is the longest National Highway in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 2)
